scope: Static acquisition only; no physics/control changes
precontact_reference: reset original q_ref then performCollisionDetection and read native manifolds plus fresh closest
post_entry_reference: reset original q_ref, read current-transform fresh getClosestPoints without updating persistent broadphase collisions; raw_manifolds=null and raw_manifolds_requested=false
proxy: Every snapshot reset independent q_proxy then performCollisionDetection and read all native manifolds; original strict gates mandatory
no_zero_fabrication: Reference geometry audit solver manifold fields are null, never claimed empty/zero from observation
rationale: Avoid reference motor-overclosure creating persistent contacts that contaminate proxy observation. No filter/white-list/threshold change.
unchanged_full_guards: Reference and proxy retain all target-independent gates. Before lift, target checks retain their registered rules. During lift and hold, registered robot/target surface and contact geometry are diagnostics in the frozen-target scene; raw identity, finite values, witness arithmetic, and all dynamic checks remain enforced.
